governing_principle: Listener gate thresholds remain uncalibrated pending frozen model representations. Composer generalization gate is not ready for calibration pending Stage-1 Composer generation.

PREDICTIVE_GATE.metric: Negative log-likelihood perplexity / bit-rate on held-out human corpus segments
PREDICTIVE_GATE.provisional_threshold_description: Perplexity improvement over empirical n-gram and Markov baselines
PREDICTIVE_GATE.calibration_prerequisite: Stage-0 Artificial Listener representation model trained on development cohort

INVARIANCE_GATE.metric: Cosine similarity of representations under identity-preserving transformations T_ID
INVARIANCE_GATE.provisional_threshold_description: Median cosine similarity >= tau_inv (provisional 0.85 pending Youden's J calibration)
INVARIANCE_GATE.calibration_prerequisite: Frozen Listener encoder representation evaluated on transformation registry T_ID

DISCRIMINATION_GATE.metric: Negative-foil similarity separation (cosine distance margin or AUROC) against matched foils
DISCRIMINATION_GATE.provisional_threshold_description: AUROC >= tau_auroc (provisional 0.95) and foil cosine similarity <= tau_foil (provisional 0.30)
DISCRIMINATION_GATE.calibration_prerequisite: Frozen Listener encoder representation evaluated on matched negative-foil pool

COUNTERFACTUAL_GATE.metric: Directional contrast response (ClosureContrast, SurpriseContrast) vs matched neutral controls
COUNTERFACTUAL_GATE.provisional_threshold_description: Statistically significant directional separation: lower 95% BCa bootstrap CI > 0
COUNTERFACTUAL_GATE.calibration_prerequisite: Counterfactual perturbations CF-CLOSURE and CF-SURPRISE applied to frozen Listener

LONG_RANGE_MEMORY_GATE.metric: Memory reactivation ratio and latent divergence upon theme reprise vs novel material
LONG_RANGE_MEMORY_GATE.provisional_threshold_description: Reactivation ratio >= tau_react (provisional 1.80) and memory delta >= tau_mem (provisional 0.50)
LONG_RANGE_MEMORY_GATE.calibration_prerequisite: Frozen Listener state dynamics evaluated on multi-section development pieces with matched neutral controls

ANTI_COPY_GATE.metric: Three-tier anti-copy metric: symbolic n-gram overlap, information-weighted interval n-gram, nearest-neighbor latent retrieval
ANTI_COPY_GATE.provisional_threshold_description: Max contiguous match <= 12 notes and latent nearest-neighbor distance >= tau_copy (provisional 0.05)
ANTI_COPY_GATE.calibration_prerequisite: Corpus development n-gram language models and frozen representation lookup index

COMPOSER_GENERALIZATION_GATE.metric: Composer perplexity degradation on held-out human pieces vs generated repertoire distribution
COMPOSER_GENERALIZATION_GATE.calibration_prerequisite: Stage-1 Composer generation and Stage-0 Artificial Listener counterfactual critic operationalization

SOURCE_SEGMENT_INVARIANCE.metric: Representation cosine similarity under algorithmic identity-preserving transformations T_ID_1..7 applied to physical score segments
SOURCE_SEGMENT_INVARIANCE.provisional_threshold_description: Optimal operational threshold tau_id prospective calibration via Youden's J on development folds
SOURCE_SEGMENT_INVARIANCE.calibration_prerequisite: Frozen representation embeddings of development segments and their T_ID transforms

THEME_MOTIF_IDENTITY.metric: Cross-variation and development-section thematic motif embedding concordance
THEME_MOTIF_IDENTITY.provisional_threshold_description: Unassigned pending verified human thematic motif annotations
THEME_MOTIF_IDENTITY.calibration_prerequisite: Dual-blind musicological annotation of motif boundaries and variants with inter-annotator agreement Cohen's kappa >= 0.80
